ABS Non-Conformity : Requirement: 
Per SE Manual, PR-1001, Section 5.5 Routing maintenance, the C/O and 2/E need to ensure that the ship is properly maintained and operated so that it remains in conformance with all applicable international standards and requirements. 
Evidence: 
While walkabout inspection during this audit, the following hardware deficiencies were observed:
1. No.1 C/H Mechanical Ventilation Trunk (STBD) in way of Fr. 260/ 2nd Deck was corroded/ holed.
2. No.2 C/H Mechanical Ventilation Trunks (Port & STBD) in way of Fr. 228/ 2nd Deck were corroded/ holed.
3. Cargo Hatch Cover No. 5H. CP, No. 7H. S, No. 9 H. CP, No. 12 H. C & No. 12 H. S’s side coaming lower edge were corroded/ holed.
4. Hatch Coaming Stay Stiffener’s toe in way of FR. 248/ Upper Deck/ Port & STBD were fractured.
5. Cable Penetration Device in way FR. 10/ 2nd Deck/ STBD was not properly sealed after modification (CCTV Installation).
Nature of NC:
The ship was not properly maintained and operated in compliance with the requirements.

ABS Non-Conformity : Requirement: 
As per EMC Marine Circular (Ref. No. 2025-017), Attachment 1 "Emergency Generator Test Items and Procedure Guide", a risk assessment must be done before testing, and testing can only be carried out after ensuring safety of ship, personnel and cargo.
Evidence: 
There is no risk assessment record being found since the Marine Circular (Ref. No. 2025-017) was published.
Nature of NC: 
The risk assessment was not carried out to identify such equipment and was categorized as a Nonconformity.
